_note: Shot list for the visual pass (bd wso): Florida, the temple, the ruins and bunker, the UI, dialogue and the interview. Render with tools/shot_walk.sh tools/shots/wso.json <out_dir>; the format is in project/scripts/test/shot_walk.gd. Names are <area>-<scene>-<state>. The seed is the state every shot opens with (island chapter, day 4 morning, two pieces of Forbidden Knowledge recovered and one tactic in the journal); a shot's flags go over it. Overviews frame the whole map; the other map shots are the game's own view (zoom 2, the camera on the player).
